label: ABSOLUTELY_TRUE_1: TruthSemantics.trueAbs p: p is true in the unindexed sense, not relative to any…
definition: `TruthSemantics.trueAbs p`: p is true in the unindexed sense, not relative to any agent. No link to relative truth is built in.
note: Test semantics for retorsion. It is the unindexed predicate of the all-opinions-true target (DEF-ALL-OPINIONS-TRUE-UNINDEXED), not DEF-OBJECTIVE-TRUTH (attitude-independence) and not the truth of things (DEF-ONTOLOGICAL-TRUTH).
